display.fallback: Bodoni Moda, Didot, Noto Serif KR

heading.fallback: Bodoni Moda, Didot, Noto Serif KR

chart.value_label: 13pt EB Garamond, tabular figures, on bar/vertex end, highlight value #A8893E
chart.line: 1pt hairline solid, highlight #A8893E / secondary #C4B79A, markers 5px endpoints (1px #EDE6D6 stroke), no area fill, straight segments
chart.donut: thin ring ~18% of radius, <=3 segments, highlight #A8893E rest #C4B79A, center 56pt Playfair Display key figure
chart.render: SVG precise, 0px corners, no border box, no legend box, no shadow, no 3D, no area-fill
chart.source: unit note + bottom-right 10pt italic caption mandatory

diagram.language: luxury hairline; 0.75pt gold #A8893E hairline skeleton, no/light fill, 0px corners, active 1 only gold, generous side whitespace
diagram.node: no fill or #F4EFE3 + 0.75pt #A8893E hairline border, 1.9x0.95in, 0px radius, padding 0.3in, centered
diagram.step_badge: 0.36in circle, 0.75pt #A8893E hairline border, no fill, Playfair Display 16pt #3A2E1F; active #A8893E
diagram.process: horizontal, <=4 steps, node gap 0.5in, centered 17pt EB Garamond label + 11pt #8A7C63 sub
diagram.timeline: horizontal 0.75pt #A8893E hairline axis, 7px circle markers (no fill + 0.75pt #A8893E, current #A8893E fill), <=5 markers
diagram.comparison: 2-3 col center-symmetric, 0.75pt #A8893E vertical hairline, no col fill, kicker + 0.6in gold rule, centered, gold ◆ or italic 'vs'
diagram.matrix: 0.75pt #A8893E hairline cross axes, no quadrant fill, no-fill circle points + highlight #A8893E, generous side margins
diagram.hierarchy: 3-4 level trapezoid, no/light #F4EFE3 fill + 0.75pt #A8893E outline, key level outline #A8893E or 56pt gold KPI
diagram.kpi_card: #F4EFE3 or no fill + 0.75pt #A8893E hairline, 0px radius, padding 0.3in, center-symmetric; 56pt Playfair Display gold figure + 11pt kicker + delta ▲#A8893E/▼#8A7C63
diagram.render: SVG precise, no div blocks, 0px corners, center axis, generous whitespace, gold restraint (no large gold fill)
